question: Why do bondage and liberation not ultimately differ when viewed from Śiva-ness?
premises: Bondage and liberation are ordinarily distinguished.
All reality is grounded in Śiva-ness.
From the standpoint of Śiva-ness, ultimate difference collapses.
inference: Bondage and liberation do not truly differ everywhere because of Śiva-ness.
plain_english: Bondage and liberation do not differ at all, because of Śiva-ness everywhere.
